doubleRotationCombinations.title: 横屏声明 × 竖屏真实像素 × 90/270 矩阵
doubleRotationCombinations.analysis: Raw pixels need 3 clockwise quarter-turn(s) to become upright, but the compliant matrix applies 1. The matrix-respecting image still needs 2 quarter-turn(s); a bake plus matrix or manual filter is rotating the picture twice/in the wrong direction.
doubleRotationCombinations.fix: Extract with -noautorotate, compare against an upright reference, then choose exactly one transform: keep the matrix or bake the correct rotation and strip the matrix.

doubleRotationCombinations.title: 已烘入像素的旋转 × 仍生效的显示矩阵
doubleRotationCombinations.analysis: Pixels were already rotated 1 quarter-turn(s) clockwise before encoding, and the display matrix requests the same 1 turn(s). A matrix-respecting player applies both, totaling 2 quarter-turn(s).
doubleRotationCombinations.consequence: For 90/270-degree cases the image is usually upside down (180 degrees total); players that ignore the matrix show the sideways baked frame instead.
doubleRotationCombinations.fix: If pixels are already correct, strip/identity the matrix. If pixels are baked sideways, either replace the matrix with the one true correction or bake that correction and write an identity matrix; never do both.

doubleRotationCombinations.title: 默认自动旋转 × 再手动 transpose/rotate
doubleRotationCombinations.analysis: FFmpeg-based tools and many players apply display-matrix autorotation by default. Running transpose/rotate again on that already-normalized frame applies the matrix a second time. The generated 03-double-rotated PNG reproduces this exact pipeline mistake.
doubleRotationCombinations.consequence: Two successive matrix-equivalent turns; for a 90-degree metadata value this commonly produces a 180-degree wrong frame.
doubleRotationCombinations.fix: Use either default autorotate with no rotation filter, or -noautorotate followed by exactly one explicitly chosen correction.

doubleRotationCombinations.title: 旧 rotate 标签 × Display Matrix 被当成两次变换
doubleRotationCombinations.fix: Normalize to one display matrix. Do not add a tag-derived filter when the demuxer/player already exposes/applies side-data rotation.

doubleRotationCombinations.title: 显示宽高 × 矩阵换轴 × 真实像素宽高
doubleRotationCombinations.analysis: tkhd width/height already match the matrix-swapped dimensions while the same quarter-turn matrix remains active. FFmpeg derives an implied SAR of 3.160; SAR-aware rotation then reciprocates that SAR and can change the final display orientation/aspect. Dimension-only players, SAR-aware players, and transcode pipelines can therefore choose different swaps or scaling.
doubleRotationCombinations.consequence: One consumer may use tkhd as final display size, another applies the matrix and swaps again, while another honors the implied SAR; this produces inconsistent orientation or stretched frames.
doubleRotationCombinations.fix: Keep tkhd dimensions in the pre-matrix track coordinate system for square pixels, or explicitly author a valid anamorphic SAR. Do not pre-swap tkhd width/height and leave the rotation matrix active.

frames.description: FFmpeg -noautorotate: true coded pixel grid, with no display matrix applied.
FFmpeg default autorotate: the same matrix-aware behavior expected from a compliant player.
Default autorotated frame rotated again by the same matrix quarter-turn: the C3 pipeline mistake.
No-autorotate pixels rotated exactly 0 degrees clockwise; visually choose the upright candidate.
No-autorotate pixels rotated exactly 90 degrees clockwise; visually choose the upright candidate.
No-autorotate pixels rotated exactly 180 degrees clockwise; visually choose the upright candidate.
No-autorotate pixels rotated exactly 270 degrees clockwise; visually choose the upright candidate.
Corrected from raw pixels with exactly 270 clockwise degree(s), source=reference-image-mae.
Numbered contact sheet: 1 raw pixels, 2 matrix-aware output, 3 double-rotation pipeline, 4 selected correction.

conclusion: 检测到 3 个高风险文件元数据/像素组合（C1-landscape-claim-portrait-pixels-quarter-matrix, C2-baked-pixels-plus-active-display-matrix, C5-display-width-height-vs-matrix-axis-swap）。必须以 -noautorotate 原始像素为准，并用参考图或显式方向确定唯一修正；不要在默认 autorotate 的结果上再次 transpose。
nextSteps: 先打开 01-raw-pixels-noautorotate.png，确认编码像素网格的真实方向；不要用播放器窗口尺寸代替它。
再打开 02-matrix-respecting-player.png，它代表遵循 Display Matrix 的播放器/FFmpeg 默认 autorotate 结果。
检查 rotation-report.md 中 C1-C5 的状态；高风险项表示已证实或高度疑似二次旋转。
以 04-corrected.png 为准；修复文件时要么清除/改写 tkhd 矩阵，要么烘入唯一旋转后写单位矩阵，不能两者同时保留。
repairCommands: ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -noautorotate -i 'examples/double-rotation.mp4' -vf 'transpose=2' -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a copy corrected-baked.mp4
# 禁止：默认 autorotate 抽帧后再按 ffprobe rotation 手动 transpose；这会复现 03-double-rotated PNG。
